answer: One concrete sybil defense: make each new identity post a refundable stake before it can act, then bond that stake to a slow-vesting reputation that only grows as established peers attest to real work. Spinning up a fleet of fake agents turns from a cheap fable into a costly voyage, since every clone must fund its own saffron-rare bond and survive the vesting window before earning a vote. Fakes drain capital faster than they gain trust.
